lines:
Responsibilities: Provides the storage-mechanics startup gate for the core Recovery Coordinator across the deliberate multi-medium boundary: canonical/event SQLite, disposable indexes, versioned JSON, artifact/evidence files, debug capture, and rotating logs. It coordinates compatibility, migrations, integrity checks, crash-consistent backup, quarantine, validated restore, and projection rebuild.
Owned records/files: StorageSchemaManifestV1 with per-store format/min-reader/min-writer versions; exclusive maintenance lease/generation; migration journal and step hashes; IntegrityReportV1; quarantine markers; and BackupManifestV1 containing SQLite snapshot, accepted JSON generations/hashes, referenced artifact hashes, creation version, completeness, and restore verification. Capture/log payloads are excluded from backup by default.
Keys and ordering: migration IDs are unique and strictly ordered per store; every step is restart-idempotent and records from/to version and checksum. BackupId/content manifest identifies a consistent generation; modification times never decide validity.
Ports: exposes CheckStartupCompatibility, RunMigration, VerifyIntegrity, CreateBackup, ValidateRestore, PromoteRestore, RebuildDisposableProjections, and ReleaseStartupGate only to the core Recovery Coordinator. It calls maintenance ports on every local repository; it does not expose data to workers/hosts.
Durability/migration/recovery: acquires exclusive maintenance before writes; makes and verifies a backup before destructive migration; performs SQLite changes transactionally and JSON/filesystem changes through staged fsync/rename plus a resumable journal, preserving unknown fields. Newer unsupported schema opens inspectable read-only. Corruption quarantines only the affected store; restore occurs to staging, passes schema/hash/sequence checks, then is atomically promoted. No automatic salvage overwrites original evidence.
Startup/retention/performance: quick compatibility/integrity checks target under two seconds for normal stores; full artifact/database scrubs are cancellable/lazy. Backups are deduplicated and retained by configurable count/size with at least one last-known-good generation protected; restore reports space requirements before copy. Projection rebuild is resumable and never blocks canonical reads longer than the maintenance gate requires.
Security/non-responsibilities: backup/migration inputs reject secret values; opaque credential references survive unchanged. This coordinator does not choose LocalSqlite versus PortableProject, repair semantic facts, decide whether a Chat may continue, replay model/tool/external calls, compensate effects, rewrite forward-unknown JSON, activate repairs, or treat a disposable portable index as authority.

data.name: Schema, Integrity, Migration & Backup Coordinator
data.technology: Rust storage maintenance coordinator using SQLite backup and atomic filesystem staging
